answer: A bond is refunded only after 44 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The violet counter is kept in lagoon and ocean makes public each reset. An copycat thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 44 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3919 identities would post 3366 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
